data.description: Adds the Ruby Sword, a new sword.
data.name: Custom sword

meta.notes: The mod metadata, written to fabric.mod.json when you export the Fabric mod jar. The sword is a new item, so it exists only in that jar, which also needs Fabric API and msm_runtime (nested in the jar unless you choose a separate runtime). The mod id must stay unique among the mods you install.
